lines.x: The planned TAZARA revitalisation is expected to raise freight capacity twelvefold and shorten transport times across Eastern, Central and Southern Africa.
Tanzania's Mining and Investment Conference in Dar es Salaam said the Barrick-Twiga joint investment has a bright future.
At the opening of Mining Conference 2026, Tanzania invited investors into gold refining, nickel and copper processing, heavy mineral sands and niobium.
Tanzania's government has introduced measures to ensure minerals are processed and value-added before export.
